A '''Great Hunt''' was held by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] sometime between [[3678 BBY]] and [[3668 BBY]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as the [[Defenestrator]] emerged victorious in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|competition]], despite protests from some competitors.
